scope: Vec class: all operators declared in class, defined outside; sort by operator<
description: A 2D integer vector class with arithmetic, comparison, compound assignment, subscript, unary minus, prefix ++ and chained copy assignment, sorted in a vector.
tricky_aspect: Overloaded const and non-const operator[] returning references through a ternary, chained copy assignment e = f = ..., and compound assignment chained via (d -= a) -= b.

scope: Fraction class with out-of-class operators, recursive gcd helper, sorting
description: A normalized fraction class with arithmetic, comparison, prefix ++, compound assignment and sorting by operator<.
tricky_aspect: Negative denominators normalized in a constructor defined outside, implicit int-to-Fraction conversion in h -= 3, and operator-= implemented via operator- and copy assignment.

scope: 2x2 matrix class with pointer-returning operator[], array member initializer, recursive power
description: A 2x2 long long matrix with multiplication, addition, subtraction, compound ops, double subscripting, and fast exponentiation by recursion to compute Fibonacci.
tricky_aspect: operator[] returns long long* so m[0][0] = 7 chains a second built-in subscript, and the array member is initialized with nested braces in an out-of-class constructor initializer list.

scope: Polynomial class with fixed array, operator[] overloads, recursive Horner evaluation, sorting
description: A degree-limited polynomial class with arithmetic, unary minus, comparison by degree, subscript with clamping, and recursive evaluation.
tricky_aspect: Overloaded const/non-const operator[] with clamped index used as an lvalue (r[i + j] += ...) inside const member operators, plus a default argument on a recursive member declared only in the class.

scope: Heap-owning string class (rule of three) with all operators defined outside; sorting an array of objects
description: A dynamic C-string wrapper with copy constructor, destructor, assignment, concatenation, repeat, reverse, case change via prefix ++, comparison and subscript.
tricky_aspect: Self-assignment through a reference, a destructor/copy-constructor pair interacting with operator+ building into a local after deleting its buffer, and right-associative a += b += c compound chain.

scope: Money class plus stream-like Receipt with member operator<< returning *this; unnamed prototype parameters
description: A money value type in cents with arithmetic and comparison, sorted in an array, and a Receipt builder that chains operator<< overloads.
tricky_aspect: Several overloaded member operator<< on Receipt chained in one expression where an int literal must pick the int overload rather than the implicit Money(long long) conversion, with a Money member initialized as total(0).

scope: Time-of-day class with modular arithmetic, pointer to object, array of objects, recursive minimum
description: A time-of-day class that wraps at 24 hours, with arithmetic, subscript for h/m/s, prefix ++, comparisons, and a recursive earliest-time finder over an array.
tricky_aspect: Negative modular wrap-around in operator- and unary minus, ++*p through a pointer to an array element, and a recursive function returning a const reference chosen by a conditional over operator<.

scope: Complex-integer class with out-of-class operators plus a Log class with overloaded member operator<< chaining
description: A Gaussian-integer class with arithmetic, norm-ordered comparison, compound assignment chains and sorting, printed through a chaining Log object.
tricky_aspect: Log::operator<< overloads for Cplx, int, const char* and char must be resolved per argument in one chain (int literal 42 versus implicit Cplx(int), a char literal versus int), and a = b chained assignment feeding c = a = b.

a*b= 5+5i | 4+1i -2+3i 42 (3 complex)
chain 3-1i 3-1i (2 complex)
10-3i -10+3i 5-1i (3 complex)
3+8i 5 6 (1 complex)
